messages:
Ivy: Noticed a hole in telemetry aggregates for a handful of EU tenants (roughly 10h window). thinking a targeted scrub/recompute.
Marco: How big is the window and estimated work?
Ivy: ~60 shards, ~1100 tasks. if we run staggered it should be cheap; fast path would finish in ~40m but uses reserved slots.
Sana: prefer staggered by default. If tenant-admin toggles fast path, require allow_fast_recompute flag.
Marco: Agree. API design: accept ?fast=true for console and header X-Fast-Recompute:1 for infra; header should trump param.
Ivy: add prefetch_phase=true to warm KV caches before heavy work. that reduced cost last time.
quota-bot: Note: current recompute:burst tokens allow ~3 concurrent fast runs for EU region.
Ivy: good. Ops: start a 3-shard canary with prefetch and staggered fallback.
ops-bot: Job queued scrub-6977770000 id=rb-2025-06-18-0900 fast=false prefetch=true
Marco: UI: show an explicit cost estimate and a modal that explains "fast uses reserved capacity". no surprises.
Sana: add short-term SLI watch: dedicated_host_p95 & recompute_cpu_p95 for 2h, alert if >6% regression.
Ivy: canary started. will post cache-miss and spend after first batch.
ops-bot: Canary done: cache_miss 5%, cpu delta +2%, proceeding to staggered roll with concurrency=6.
